request.style: English, warm acoustic folk, gentle male vocal, fingerpicked acoustic guitar, mandolin, upright bass, light hand percussion, unhurried and pastoral, 88 BPM
request.lyrics:
[Verse]
The Father is the gardener who tends the vine with care
He takes away the barren wood and prunes the branches there
So every branch that bears its fruit will bear its fruit the more
And we are clean already by the word he spoke before

[Chorus]
I am the vine; you are the branches
Whoever remains in me and I in him bears much fruit
For apart from me you can do nothing
Remain in me, and I in you

[Verse]
A branch can't bear fruit by itself, it needs the vine to grow
It withers when it's broken off and lies in dust below
But if you stay with me, he said, and my words in you remain
Then ask whatever you may wish, you will not ask in vain

[Chorus]
I am the vine; you are the branches
Whoever remains in me and I in him bears much fruit
For apart from me you can do nothing
Remain in me, and I in you

[Bridge]
This is how my Father is glorified
That you bear much fruit
And so prove to be my disciples

[Outro]
Remain in me, and I in you
I am the vine; you are the branches
